book.name: 1 TESALONIKA
book.title: IGI NAMBA WAN PAULO MENE TESALONIKA EMO DUBU ENO GAENA

content: Paulo nung Tuwa mene gai iwaing yaise auna gege sena.
Otao mani nana, ninae-una atu kasa yero buro yewangne buro awiya me aung oko yena auna susuwa awiya niye nika niyetope gosineya.

Gitau nae ninae-una atu oko kasa yaore Filipai nape atu awong nae dero gona yewa awiya nigitinowa. Ayero yewa, arata saineba, oko turewangne. Aung ara. Tuwa naname mene nae soreuno putoung pugainu tau yero ninae-una buro yaya tapunasani Tuwa Bayaura Bowi Iwaing awiya sero keregaingwane ara.
Dawong gayao ge sewangne auna susuwa awiya ge iwao saora atu oko mitiya. Niye pasena yaese oko sewangne. Niye etegari oko yewangne.

Tuwa Bayau mene nae giginu teng yenu giro Bowi Iwaing sero sero yanenese sena auna teng sinonane. Emo mene nae gaya iwaing yao auna okowata, Tuwa Bayau nung dubo gaora maung mene nae gai iwaing yari aeno gege sinonane.
Niye nae gosinowa. Nae dawong gayao ge zo niye eno oko sewangne. Nupema uritira gera desetiro wau moni eno zo oko yewangne, awiya Tuwa Bayau mene nigitini aune sinena.

Ninaeta emo ena mene nae bowi yaese oko sewangne. Nae Kristora aposolo yero nonane, arare nae ninae-una atu emo babuze yero mitasani niye yanakana dedunasani kora yanane teng yatiya. Arata saineba, ayero oko yewangne.
Aung arauwa. Bauno zo mene mani nuna zo kora noiya aine nae ninae-una atu etutero naungwane ara.

Dubora mono nanae mene ninae-una mitauna, arare Tuwa Bayaura Bowi Iwaing niye eno tugata yao awiya gege okowata, niye eno yero nao nanae gerayao auna dema eo yewangne. Awiya dubo nanae mene niye eno yena aeno ayero yewangne.
Paulo mene maung nunae ine yero uritira ge gipena.

Otao mani, gitau otu nae ninae-ina atu nasani taungna nona eno buro baina niye eno pugonine sero, nae pingne iyare taungna buro dema kokoniyao nibamu nasani dopewangne. Ayero nasani Tuwa Bayaura Bowi Iwaing niye eno sewangne, awiya niye kotupunowita?
Nae daung mokera atu etutero pewayero pasena aung nasani ge nigao dubu niye eno tani ena yewangne. Auna niye aune Tuwa Bayau aune amimene susuwa nanae nigitinowa.

Ayero yero eyero gosinowa. Mama zo mene mani awiso nuna eno yero noiya aine nanae niye eno deka ayero yewangne. Nae niye dekaong dekaong aeno wini ge aune ato sao ge ena aune awiya sinaungwane. Nae ge eyero sinasani niye eno sewangne:
Tuwa Bayau mene napo nuna aune simao nuna aune auna maung yaese sero niye yau sinoiya, aeno niye nao nuna auna teng neupu.
Uritira ge nigitinewa iwo kasa yena.

Nae Tuwa Bayaura ge sewangne nigiwa emora ge ine oko yena. Ge awiya Tuwa Bayaura ge me ayero sero puro pu dube gaiwa. Ge awiya Tuwa Bayaura ge me ara. Ge awiya ge nigao dubu ninae-una atu buro yero noiya. Aeno nae be giti Tuwa Bayau eno dange sero nung bowi yero nonane.

Otao mani nana, Tuwa Bayaura dubu Kristo Yesura yazo nigiti nasani Yudaya tawingna atu nowa aine niye ara. Awong eno yewa deka ayero niye eno yewa. Awong Yuda emo mene dewa taung yaya tamuwa, deka aine otao mani ninae ena mene niye dewa taung yaya tamuwa ara.
Yuda emo awong Tuwa Yesu aune porofete dewa magayewa. Ayero yero nae dema dero tunero ayewa. Awong emo dubu giti awiya iwo nasani nowa. Ayero nowa Tuwa Bayau mene awong gosinoi meko yero noiya ara.

Ayero emo Yuda oko eno ge sanane nigaya Tuwa Bayau mene awong kora yao eno, nagibo nanae gazari yero nowa. Awong ayero yerota yero ayero nasani nao meko daigairo nawe duwa pasena nunae mene witao yenu giro Tuwa Bayaura tini kapao nunae-una kasa yena ara.
Paulo nung awong eno yawa yawa yena.

Otao mani, nae niye yangduwangne, arata dubo mene oko duwangne. Taung mene gege yangduwangne. Be maingkoka gege bogamasa ine yero nawe benaung ninae nupema gari ara tapunasani nupema tera ninae-una kapetegairo bari sero nasani naungwane.
Buro niye gari sewangne. Na Paulo naka natope ozaungzaung bari yewang Sanda mene na nagibo gazinauna.
Niye gari sero aratapunonane awiya susuwa euna. Tuwa naname Yesu kasa yariniya be aune nona nomi mene buro nanae auna me, o yawa bowire nanae, o simao nanae, yarinei? Niye amimene yarineya.
Arare niye amimene yazo bowire nanae, nupema yawa yawa yao nanae yarineya.
